name: sub2api-free
description: sub2api for the Cloudflare Workers Free plan: a TypeScript gateway that needs no container.

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: Password for the dashboard sign-in. At least 16 characters, for example `openssl rand -hex 24`.

MANAGEMENT_KEY.description: The management key the dashboard asks for after sign-in, as on the container install. At least 16 characters and different from DASHBOARD_PASSWORD, for example `openssl rand -hex 24`.
